text:
olivia.cs: Quick note
We're experimenting with a one-paragraph 'FastBoot' onboarding card customers can run to reduce cold-first-token delays. Aim: 3 tiny calls, low QPS, fully ephemeral. Feedback? :zap:

ben.ops: Sounds good. Must include TTL and an easy rollback. Recommend TTL=30m, max_tokens=20, and QPS cap 0.25/account.

zoe.sre: Ops recipe: two short prefill calls (seed prompts), then one streaming probe. Keep batch_size=1 for probes. If 429s occur, back off 60s and try one final probe.

olivia.cs: Customer copy idea (very short): "Run FastBoot: send 3 quick sample requests to your staging endpoint to warm caches. Keys auto-expire in 30 minutes. No training or extra retention."

ranita.pm: Include a one-question feedback link in the success flow: "Was the response fast? Yes/No". Use that signal for renewal risk scoring.

ben.ops: Rollback snippet for internal SRE: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.local/admin/cache/clear -d 'account_id=ACCT123&scope=fastboot' -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN>"`

zoe.sre: Telemetry: emit `fastboot.run.ok` or `fastboot.run.err`. If two failures within 48h, tag CRM `fastboot_needs_help` and create a CS task.

cs-bot: Action: add FastBoot card to account view (owners: cs-team, eng-platform).

olivia.cs: I'll draft the one-paragraph customer card and an internal triage checklist. Will post in channel tomorrow AM for a quick review. :rocket:
